_note: The model may tap ONLY these zones, by name, and only when the user's message names the zone. Screen is 720 wide x 1280 tall. If requires_text is set, the script reads the screen first and taps the center of the matching text inside 'area'; if it is not found, nothing is tapped. Restart ldagent.ps1 after editing.

zones.name: giveaway_box
zones.description: Black 'Giveaway' box at the top right of a live stream. Opens the giveaway panel.

zones.name: enter_giveaway
zones.description: White 'Enter Giveaway' button in the open giveaway panel. If you are not yet following the host it reads 'Follow Host & Enter Giveaway' and also follows the host.
